svg.aria-label: Presence Service: one user on web, mobile and desktop, each sending a heartbeat every 30 seconds. The phone stops without a close frame; the monitor, sweeping every 10 seconds, reaps its session after 60 seconds of silence while the user stays online through the web session. When the web tab goes away the effective status becomes away, and one Redis PUBLISH reaches watchers on another instance.
